channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: New defence growth deal worth millions announced for Scotland
item.description: The UK Government has unveiled a GBP 50 million defence growth deal aimed at strengthening Scotland’s role in advanced engineering, shipbuilding and defence technology. The post New defence growth deal worth millions announced for Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK offers funding for two defence tech colleges in Scotland
item.description: The UK government has urged the Scottish Government to match funding for two proposed defence technical colleges, with ministers arguing the facilities are needed to support a growing defence order book and rising demand for skilled workers. The post UK offers funding for two defence tech colleges in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Fire breaks out aboard American carrier in Red Sea
item.description: A small, non-combat-related fire broke out aboard the US aircraft carrier USS Gerald R. Ford while it was operating in the Red Sea, according to the US Navy. The post Fire breaks out aboard American carrier in Red Sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American KC-135 tanker lost during operation over Iraq
item.description: A U.S. Air Force KC-135 aerial refuelling aircraft has been lost over Iraq during ongoing military operations in the region, according to U.S. Central Command. The post American KC-135 tanker lost during operation over Iraq first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO and allies test rapid deployment across Europe
item.description: Exercise STEADFAST FOXTROT 2026 will see NATO commands and member states test the rapid deployment and sustainment of forces across Europe. The post NATO and allies test rapid deployment across Europe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: What next for the UK-US special relationship?
item.description: Recent tensions over Iran risk damaging the UK–US ‘special relationship’, and responsibility lies with Washington rather than London, argues former British diplomat Greg Quinn OBE. The post What next for the UK-US special relationship? first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD says no earlier offer of warship to defend Cyprus
item.description: The Royal Navy did not make a formal offer earlier this year to deploy a Type 45 destroyer before HMS Dragon was eventually sent to the eastern Mediterranean, the Ministry of Defence has claimed. The post MOD says no earlier offer of warship to defend Cyprus first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Counter-terrorism podcast returns with explosive new series
item.description: A podcast offering insight into the work of UK Counter Terrorism Policing has returned for a second series, featuring interviews with officers and specialists involved in national security operations. The post Counter-terrorism podcast returns with explosive new series first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Plans set out for new veteran support centre network
item.description: The government has outlined plans for a new network of support centres intended to improve access to services for veterans across the UK. The post Plans set out for new veteran support centre network first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Leonardo targets huge revenue boost by 2030
item.description: Italian aerospace and defence group Leonardo has outlined plans to significantly expand orders, revenue and profitability by the end of the decade as part of an updated industrial strategy covering the period from 2026 to 2030, according to the company. The post Leonardo targets huge revenue boost by 2030 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
